evals.name: broken-rover-gets-repair
evals.prompt: A rover is reported broken. File the repairs that are needed.
evals.expected_output: One valid game/field/repair-rover-2.json, accepted on the first write, and a one-line report.

assertions.text: repair-rover-2.json has exactly the four keys, with the current sol
The first repair file written was accepted (one write, no FIELD REJECTED)
No hook blocked or rejected anything
Final message is one line with four ' | ' fields, starting with its own name
After resolve, rover-2 is no longer broken

evals.name: no-broken-rover
evals.prompt: Check the rovers and file any repairs that are needed.
evals.expected_output: No repair file, and a one-line report saying no repairs were needed.

assertions.text: No hook blocked or rejected anything
Final message is one line with four ' | ' fields, starting with its own name
